extension.description: Manage multiple development task contexts and record your workflow.
config.includeOpenFiles: Include the list of open editor files in snapshots
config.includeChangedPaths: Include changed file paths in the git status summary (no file contents)
config.locale: Interface language for Crazy Universe views, prompts, and the status bar
config.worklog.enabled: Enable experimental Feishu worklog plugin sync (in-house plugin only, not official work-hour management; not generally applicable)
config.worklog.running: Whether the Feishu worklog tool is currently running
config.worklog.userId: Feishu worklog user id. If sign-in still reports a missing user id, search for this setting and paste the id (digits, or starting with ou_).
